issues.detail: The Greek 'απηγγειλαν' (apēngeilan) means 'related/narrated/told', but the Vietnamese structure 'thuật lại cho họ biết... cách nào' (narrated to them... how) adds a specific inquiry or manner ('cách nào') that is not present in the Greek text. The Greek simply says they told them [about the fact] that the demon-possessed one was saved.
